newsitem.title: USA: First Bank System closes U.S. Bancorp deal.
newsitem.headline: First Bank System closes U.S. Bancorp deal.

text.p: First Bank System Inc said Friday it has completed the acquisition of Portland, Ore.-based U.S. Bancorp.
The company will be known as U.S. Bancorp and will be headquartered in Minneapolis effective today.

On Monday, August 4, U.S. Bancorp's shares will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker USB.N, First Bank said. The merger creates a company with $72 billion in assets and a market capitalization of $22 billion. It is the 14th largest bank holding company in the U.S. based on assets and the 10th largest based on market capitalization.
